note: Both sets accurately extract the technical claims regarding the PID controller response, term effects, and design recommendations from the text. Set A is preferred because it is less redundant; Set B contains two pairs of duplicate claims (generator-torque damping and rotor-speed response), whereas Set A only contains one pair (generator-torque damping). While Set B includes slightly more detailed conditions (e.g., 'active pitch-to-feather'), the increased noise from duplicate extractions makes Set A the cleaner and more efficient set.
